name: Hunter's Ashe
description: Levels fast to 8 behind a Riftbeast frontline and rolls down for a 3-star Ashe, using the full 5-unit Hunter line so her 'unmoved Hunters gain Damage Amp' bonus applies to a backline carry that never repositions.

carries.itemNotes: Crit and armor-shred items both scale her frost-arrow volley; Bloodthirster is a fine 4th/replacement item for sustain into long fights.
Attack-speed/on-hit items over raw AD; she is the secondary carry and dies to itemize her like a second hypercarry.

boardPositioning.notes: The Elder Dragon occupies two hexes (it counts as 2 board slots); keep it and Krug centered to eat the front-line dive so Ashe and Sivir, in the back corners, never need to move mid-fight.

levelPlan.notes: Hit 8 on curve; slot in Elder Dragon/Krug and start rolling for Ashe and Sivir 2-star as a floor.
Spend remaining gold rolling for a 3-star Ashe, the comp's win condition.

earlyOpener: Play fast: take every augment and unit that helps hit level 4 by 2-1 and level 6 by 3-2. Use cheap Riftbeast/Hunter 1-costs like Cinderling as an econ-friendly early frontline, but do not spend gold 2-starring them.
pivotNotes: This comp needs 8 gold to function since Ashe is a 5-cost. If HP is too low to safely reach level 8 by stage 4, pivot down to a level-6 Hunter line using Caitlyn as a temporary carry, keeping the same Riftbeast frontline until HP stabilizes.
